verdicts.title: Topological Complexity of the Klein bottle
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that the (normalized) topological complexity of the Klein bottle is $4$. We also show that, for any $g\geq 2$, $TC(N_g)=4$. This completes the recent work by Dranishnikov on the topological complexity of non-orientable surfaces.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns topological complexity (a Schwarz-genus-type invariant) of non-orientable surfaces, with no mention of resolution proofs, proof width, or counting vertices with non-trivial fundamental groups. It shares only the broad 'topology' vocabulary and does not interact with the specific bound claimed.
